catalyst.name: Touch of Malice Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds. Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon or missing removes all stacks...usually.
Precision damage increase at 1|2|3... stacks:
4.17% | 8.33% | 12.5% | 16.67% | 20.83% | 25%
